narr: Scattered slow moving thunderstorms produced heavy rain and even some hail across portions of the area. Portions of Houston and Henry counties saw some flash flooding.
ev: County Road 73 was flooded at County Road 83 South.
Flooding occurred on portions of US Highway 431 near Kinsey.
County Road 22 was flooded at County Road 13.
Flooding was reported on portions of WH Graddy Road and Broad Street.
A car was stuck in the median on US Highway 431 with flooding up to the passenger window.
lsr: Report of flooding at Broad Street and WH Graddy Road.
Additional flooding reported along US-431. Car stuck in median, flooded up to the passenger window.
County Road 73 flooded at County Road 83 South.
